errors.evidence: The description incorrectly maps the colors for two regions. According to the legend, Montana is represented by purple, not yellow, and Pleven is represented by light blue/cyan, not purple.

errors.text_span: през 2016 г. най-високият дял е около 55% (Враца)
errors.evidence: In 2016, the highest bar corresponds to Vidin (Видин) with a value of approximately 56%. The bar for Vratsa (Враца) is visibly lower, at about 53%.

errors.text_span: през 2020 г. най-високият дял е около 48% (Враца)
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly identifies the region with the highest share in 2020 and its value. The highest bar belongs to Montana (Монтана) at approximately 43%, not Vratsa (Враца) at 48%.
The description incorrectly identifies the region with the lowest share in 2020. The lowest bar belongs to Lovech (Ловеч) at approximately 27%. Montana (Монтана) has the highest share for that year.
